description: Ask for the right size, try on the clothes, and complete your purchase.

dialogue.en: Excuse me. Do you have this in a small?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，这件有小号吗？
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Let me check. Yes, we do. Here you go.
dialogue.zh: 我帮您查一下。有的，给您。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Perfect. Thank you!
dialogue.zh: 太好了，谢谢！
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Where are the fitting rooms?
dialogue.zh: 请问试衣间在哪里？
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: They’re right over there.
dialogue.zh: 就在那边。
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: How did everything fit?
dialogue.zh: 这些衣服穿着都合适吗？
dialogue.speaker: Staff

dialogue.en: Great! I’ll take these two.
dialogue.zh: 很合适！这两件我要了。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Your total is $78.45.
dialogue.zh: 一共是78.45加元。
dialogue.speaker: Cashier

dialogue.en: Credit, please.
dialogue.zh: 刷信用卡，谢谢。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Perfect. All set. Have a great day!
dialogue.zh: 好的，已经好了。祝您今天愉快！
dialogue.speaker: Cashier

dialogue.en: You too!
dialogue.zh: 您也是！
dialogue.speaker: Customer

tips.body: In Canada, clothing sizes may be shown as XS, S, M, L and XL, or as numbers.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 在加拿大，衣服尺码通常使用XS、S、M、L、XL，也可能使用数字尺码。

tips.body: At checkout, Canadians often say “Credit, please” or “I’ll pay by credit.”
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 结账时，加拿大人经常说“Credit, please”或“I’ll pay by credit”。

subtitle_cues.en: Do you have this in a small?

subtitle_cues.zh: 这些衣服穿着都合适吗？

title_en: Requesting a Price Adjustment at Costco
title_zh: 在 Costco 申请退差价
description: Ask Costco for a price adjustment after an item goes on sale.
scene_setup_en: You bought a lunch bag last week and noticed it is now on sale. At the membership counter, you ask whether the store can refund the difference.
scene_setup_zh: 你上周买了一个午餐包，后来发现它现在正在打折。你来到会员服务柜台，询问商店能否退还差价。
learning_goal_en: Learn how to request a price adjustment, provide proof of purchase, and understand the refund confirmation.
learning_goal_zh: 学习如何申请退差价、提供购买记录，并听懂退款处理完成的确认表达。

dialogue.en: Hi, I bought a lunch bag here last week, and I noticed it's on sale now. I was wondering if I could get a price adjustment?
dialogue.zh: 你好！我上周在这里买了一个午餐包，今天发现它降价了。我想问一下，可以退差价吗？
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Of course, do you have your receipt?
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。请问有购物小票吗？
dialogue.speaker: Clerk

dialogue.en: Not with me, but I think I can find it in the Costco app.
dialogue.zh: 我现在没带，不过我可以在 Costco App 里找一下。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: No worries. I can also look it up using your membership card.
dialogue.zh: 没关系。我也可以通过你的会员卡帮你查。
dialogue.speaker: Clerk

dialogue.en: I'm all set. The refund has been processed.
dialogue.zh: 好了，已经处理完成了。我会把差价退回到你原来的付款方式。
dialogue.speaker: Clerk

dialogue.en: Thank you so much.
dialogue.zh: 太感谢了！
dialogue.speaker: Customer

tips.body: Many Canadian stores offer a price adjustment if an item goes on sale shortly after you buy it.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 加拿大很多商家都提供退差价的服务，如果商品购买后短时间内降价，可以申请退还差价。

tips.body: Always keep your receipt or digital order history.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 记得保留购物小票或电子订单记录。

description: Order dishes to share, respond to the server, and pack up the leftovers.

dialogue.en: Hi! Are you ready to order?
dialogue.zh: 您好！准备好点餐了吗？
dialogue.speaker: Server

dialogue.en: Yes. We’ll start with the eggplant in tomato sauce.
dialogue.zh: 准备好了。我们先点茄子番茄酱。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: We’ll have one order of lamb chops, one order of chicken wings, and one order of beef shish.
dialogue.zh: 我们要一份羊排、一份鸡翅和一份牛肉串。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Great. Anything to drink?
dialogue.zh: 好的。需要喝点什么吗？
dialogue.speaker: Server

dialogue.en: Three Cokes, please.
dialogue.zh: 请给我们三杯可乐。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Here’s some Turkish bread with cacık and spicy ezme for the table.
dialogue.zh: 这是给全桌一起享用的土耳其面包、酸奶黄瓜酱和辣味 ezme。
dialogue.speaker: Server

dialogue.en: Here are the main courses. Are you sharing everything, or is each person having their own dish?
dialogue.zh: 主菜来了。你们是一起分享，还是每人吃自己的菜？
dialogue.speaker: Server

dialogue.en: We’re sharing everything.
dialogue.zh: 我们一起分享。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: No problem. I’ll bring you some extra plates.
dialogue.zh: 没问题。我给你们拿几个额外的盘子。
dialogue.speaker: Server

dialogue.en: How was everything?
dialogue.zh: 餐点怎么样？
dialogue.speaker: Server

dialogue.en: It was delicious. The portions were really generous.
dialogue.zh: 非常好吃，而且分量很足。
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: We still have quite a bit left. Could we get two takeout boxes, please?
dialogue.zh: 我们还剩下不少。可以给我们两个打包盒吗？
dialogue.speaker: Customer

dialogue.en: Of course. I’ll bring them right over.
dialogue.zh: 当然。我马上拿过来。
dialogue.speaker: Server

tips.body: At many Turkish restaurants, bread and small dips may be served for the whole table to share.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 在很多土耳其餐厅，面包和小份蘸酱会作为全桌共享的配套食物上桌。

tips.body: “Takeout box” is common in Canada; “to-go box” is also widely understood.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 在加拿大常说 takeout box，to-go box 也很常见。

description: Understand the dental filling process, from protective glasses and local anesthetic to bite checking and aftercare.

dialogue.en: I’m going to give you some protective glasses.
dialogue.zh: 我给您一副防护眼镜。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: Okay, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 好的，谢谢。
dialogue.speaker: Patient

dialogue.en: They’ll protect your eyes from the bright light.
dialogue.zh: 它们可以保护您的眼睛不受强光刺激。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: I’m going to numb the area first.
dialogue.zh: 我先给这个部位打麻药。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: Will I feel anything?
dialogue.zh: 我会有感觉吗？
dialogue.speaker: Patient

dialogue.en: You’ll feel a little pinch, and then it should start to feel numb.
dialogue.zh: 您会感觉轻轻扎一下，然后这里会开始变麻。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: Does this feel numb?
dialogue.zh: 这里感觉麻了吗？
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: Yes, my lip feels numb too.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我的嘴唇也感觉麻了。
dialogue.speaker: Patient

dialogue.en: That’s normal.
dialogue.zh: 这是正常的。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: I’m going to remove the decay and place the filling now.
dialogue.zh: 现在我要清理蛀坏的部分并放入补牙材料。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: You’ll feel some pressure and vibration, but it shouldn’t hurt.
dialogue.zh: 您会感觉到一些压力和震动，但应该不会疼。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: Bite down and grind left and right.
dialogue.zh: 咬紧一点，然后左右磨动牙齿。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

dialogue.en: Great.
dialogue.zh: 很好。
dialogue.speaker: Dentist

tips.body: Try not to chew until the numbness wears off, so you don’t accidentally bite your lip or the inside of your cheek.
tips.title: Tip 1
tips.bodyZh: 麻药消退前尽量不要咀嚼，以免不小心咬伤嘴唇或脸颊内侧。

tips.body: If your bite feels high or uncomfortable after the filling, contact the dental office for an adjustment.
tips.title: Tip 2
tips.bodyZh: 如果补牙后感觉咬合偏高或不舒服，请联系牙科诊所进行调磨。

subtitle_cues.en: I’m going to give you some protective glasses.
They’ll protect your eyes from the bright light.
subtitle_cues.zh: 它们可以保护您的眼睛不受强光刺激。

subtitle_cues.en: I’m going to numb the area first.
subtitle_cues.zh: 我先给这个部位打麻药。

subtitle_cues.en: You’ll feel a little pinch, and then it should start to feel numb.
subtitle_cues.zh: 您会感觉轻轻扎一下，然后这里会开始变麻。

subtitle_cues.en: Yes, my lip feels numb too.
subtitle_cues.zh: 是的，我的嘴唇也感觉麻了。

subtitle_cues.en: Let me know if you feel any pain.
I’m going to remove the decay and place the filling now.
subtitle_cues.zh: 现在我要清理蛀坏的部分并放入补牙材料。

subtitle_cues.en: You’ll feel some pressure and vibration, but it shouldn’t hurt.
subtitle_cues.zh: 您会感觉到一些压力和震动，但应该不会疼。

subtitle_cues.en: Bite down and grind left and right.
subtitle_cues.zh: 咬紧一点，然后左右磨动牙齿。

subtitle_cues.en: The anesthetic will wear off in a few hours.
subtitle_cues.zh: 麻药会在几个小时后消退。

description: Learn practical English for communicating during a dental implant procedure and understanding post-operative instructions.
scene_setup_en: A patient undergoes dental implant surgery. The dentist explains the anaesthesia, checks the patient’s comfort, places the implant, closes the area with stitches, and gives aftercare instructions.
scene_setup_zh: 患者接受种植牙手术。牙医说明麻醉过程、确认患者是否舒适、植入种植体、缝合手术区域，并讲解术后注意事项。
learning_goal_en: Understand and use practical expressions for describing sensations, signalling pain, following aftercare instructions, and arranging a follow-up visit.
learning_goal_zh: 掌握描述治疗感受、示意疼痛、遵循术后护理要求和预约复诊时的实用表达。

tips.body: We’ll be placing an implant in the missing-tooth area.
tips.title: place an implant
tips.bodyZh: 我们会在缺牙的位置植入种植体。

tips.body: I’m going to numb the area now.
tips.title: numb the area
tips.bodyZh: 我现在要给这个区域打麻药。
tips.titleZh: 给这个区域做局部麻醉

tips.body: You may feel pressure and vibration, but you shouldn’t feel any sharp pain.
tips.title: pressure and vibration
tips.bodyZh: 你可能会感觉到一些压力和震动，但不应该有明显疼痛。

tips.body: Any pain, or just pressure? — Just pressure. No pain.
tips.title: just pressure, no pain
tips.bodyZh: 有疼痛，还是只有压力感？——只有压力感，不疼。

tips.body: I’m going to close the area with a few stitches.
tips.title: close the area with stitches
tips.bodyZh: 我要缝几针，把这个区域闭合起来。

tips.body: Before treatment, dental staff in Canada may agree on a hand signal with the patient. If you cannot speak because instruments are in your mouth, raise your hand to ask the dentist to pause. “Sharp pain” means clear, acute pain, which is different from normal pressure or vibration.
tips.title: Raise your hand if you need to pause
tips.bodyZh: 在加拿大牙科诊所，治疗开始前，医护人员可能会和患者约定举手作为暂停信号。嘴里有器械、无法说话时，可以举手请医生暂停。“Sharp pain”指明显、尖锐的疼痛，与正常的压力感或震动感不同。
tips.titleZh: 不舒服时可以举手示意

tips.body: Placing the implant does not usually mean the permanent crown is fitted on the same day. The implant needs time to integrate with the bone before the crown stage. A follow-up visit is commonly arranged to check healing, and some patients may also need stitches removed. Ask: “When should I come back for a follow-up?”
tips.title: Dental implants are usually completed in stages
tips.bodyZh: 植入种植体通常不代表当天就能装上永久牙冠。种植体需要一段时间与骨组织结合，之后才进入牙冠阶段。诊所通常会安排复诊检查愈合情况，部分患者还需要拆线。可以问：“When should I come back for a follow-up?”
tips.titleZh: 种植牙通常需要分阶段完成

title_en: Parent-Teacher Meeting: Discussing a Child's Progress
title_zh: 家长会：讨论孩子的学习进展
description: Learn practical English for discussing a child's academic progress, areas for improvement, classroom participation, and follow-up support with a teacher.
scene_setup_en: A parent meets with Ethan’s teacher to discuss his overall progress, reading comprehension, focus, classroom participation, and ways to support him at home.
scene_setup_zh: 家长与 Ethan 的老师见面，讨论他的整体学习进展、阅读理解、专注力、课堂参与情况，以及在家如何给予支持。
learning_goal_en: Understand and use practical expressions for asking about a child’s school performance, discussing areas that need support, and agreeing on a follow-up plan.
learning_goal_zh: 掌握询问孩子在校表现、讨论需要加强的方面，以及商定后续跟进计划时的实用表达。

description: Learn practical English for picking up prescription medicine, asking about dosage and side effects, and using insurance at a Canadian pharmacy.
scene_setup_en: A customer picks up a prescription, confirms personal information, asks how to take the medicine and discusses side effects, insurance, and the copay.
scene_setup_zh: 顾客到药房领取处方药，确认个人信息，询问服药方法和副作用，并使用保险支付自付费用。
learning_goal_en: Understand and use practical expressions for collecting a prescription, following dosage instructions, asking about side effects, and paying with insurance.
learning_goal_zh: 掌握领取处方药、理解服药说明、询问副作用以及使用保险付款时的实用表达。
